quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Bicycle store.
Soft shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign (with the arrow below) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists may be present.

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your vehicle and other vehicles?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
It keeps traffic flowing at a safe pace.
It keeps other drivers alert.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Space between vehicles gives you time to react to mistakes made by other drivers.

questions.question: If you change your address, what must you do?

options.text: Notify the County Department of Finance when renewing your license.
Notify the County Department of Finance within 30 days of the change.
Notify the County Department of Finance only when selling or trading your car.
Do nothing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Notify the County Department of Finance within 30 days of the change.
questions.explanation: You must notify the county in writing within 30 days of changing your address. Include your new address, name, and driver license number.

questions.question: What is the "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
A special speed zone.
A roadway with restrictions on vehicle stereo volume.
The television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on each side, in the rear, and in the front. Cars cannot be seen in these spots. These areas are called the "No zone."

questions.question: At night, when another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should be:

options.text: On high beam.
On low beam.
Off. Use parking lights instead.
On either high or low beam.

questions.correctAnswerText: On low beam.
questions.explanation: Do not use high beams when another vehicle is near. Switch to low beams to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns of hazards.
It alerts drivers to school zones.
It alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
It alerts drivers to food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns of hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, you should:

options.text: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before proceeding.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is free.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with multiple tracks, do not move until you can see down all tracks. Another train may be approaching even after one passes.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.

options.text: High speeds
Slow speeds
Night driving
Uphill driving

questions.correctAnswerText: High speeds
questions.explanation: High speeds increase stopping distance and crash severity. The faster you drive, the greater the impact in a collision.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Tailgate them.
Make sure they know you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and put distance between you and the aggressive driver. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Keep right.
Keep left.
Pass with caution.
No passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way lanes separated by a divider. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: You must yield for emergency vehicles:

options.text: Under no circumstances.
When you see a flashing red or blue light or hear a siren.
Only when other vehicles yield.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you see a flashing red or blue light or hear a siren.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass when you see flashing red or blue lights or hear a siren.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
A logging road is ahead.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line dividing your lane from the lane you wish to enter is a ____ line.

options.text: Broken white
Double solid yellow
Solid yellow
Solid white

questions.correctAnswerText: Broken white
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic lanes going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the other lane is clear.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines painted down the middle of the road mean:

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead.
Pedestrian crossing ahead.
Passing is not permitted from either direction.
Passing is permitted from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not permitted from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You cannot cross these lines unless you are turning left or passing pedestrians, cyclists, or scooter riders when the opposite lane is clear and it is safe.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection that has a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to verify that there is no cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
After you have stopped at least 20 feet prior to the intersection
After slowing down to a speed of 10 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
questions.explanation: At any stop sign, come to a complete stop before the stop line or crosswalk. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not put too much thought into it because all vehicles are the same.
Hide from your friend that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Disregard any obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes before driving to familiarize yourself with the operation and location of all the vehicle's equipment.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes before driving to familiarize yourself with the operation and location of all the vehicle's equipment.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, spend a few minutes learning where and how to use the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: Your first response to reduced visibility should be:

options.text: Turning on your headlights.
Reducing your speed.
Turning on your windshield wipers.
Looking for road edge markings to guide you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reducing your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down first when visibility is reduced or road conditions are bad.

questions.question: A flashing red light on a traffic signal means:

options.text: The same thing as a stop sign.
The traffic signal is broken.
You do not have to come to a complete stop.
Driving conditions are dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, let pedestrians and traffic pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What is a "No zone?"

options.text: A designated no passing zone
A one-way traffic area
The blind spot of a large vehicle
An area designated for motor vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is a blind spot around trucks and large vehicles where the driver cannot see you. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: Another driver is passing your car. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the road.
Signal when it is safe for them to pass.
Check for oncoming cars and slow down to let them pass safely.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming cars and slow down to let them pass safely.
questions.explanation: Stay in the right lane when another driver passes you on the left. Look for oncoming traffic and slow down. This helps the passing car move back into the right lane safely and easily.

questions.question: Your tire blows out while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Slam on your brakes.
Hold the steering wheel tight and slow down to a stop.
Keep driving normally.
Turn on your flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and slow down to a stop.
questions.explanation: Do not brake hard during a blowout. Grip the steering wheel firmly to stay in your lane. Release the gas slowly and let the car slow down. When you are moving very slowly, brake gently and move to a safe area off the road.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots before changing lanes?

options.text: Use the inside rearview mirror.
Use the outside rearview mirror.
Use both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: What does an octagonal sign always mean?

options.text: Speed limit sign.
Stop sign.
Hospital sign.
Railroad warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: Octagonal signs are always stop signs. Come to a complete stop when you see a red, eight-sided sign.

questions.question: Newer cars have warning lights on the dashboard. Which statement is correct?

options.text: All warning lights should turn on when you turn the key before starting the engine.
No warning lights should turn on until the engine starts.
Warning lights should never turn on unless something is broken.
Warning lights only turn on when the headlights are on.

questions.correctAnswerText: All warning lights should turn on when you turn the key before starting the engine.
questions.explanation: All dashboard warning lights should turn on when you turn the key to the on position. If a light does not turn on, it means the light is not working.

questions.question: You see an animal on the road. What should you do?

options.text: No special action is needed.
Honk your horn.
Pass the animal as close as possible.
Be very careful.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be very careful.
questions.explanation: Be very cautious when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: It is summer.
You must stop and back up immediately.
Driving conditions are not ideal.
You should drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving conditions are not ideal.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and warn that work is happening on or near the road. Drive carefully and slowly when you see these signs.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the center line means:

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles from your direction.

questions.question: When getting ready to turn left, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down gradually while looking in your rearview mirror.
Move into the left lane.
Watch for oncoming cars and pedestrians.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Before turning left, signal 3 to 5 seconds ahead. Check your rearview mirror as you slow down. Move into the left lane before reaching the intersection. Wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear, then turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other cars?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever you can.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
Get to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and honk your horn to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
questions.explanation: Each time you pass, there is more risk of a crash. If you drive faster than other cars, you will have to keep passing. Drive at the same speed as other traffic, within the speed limit, and pass only when needed.
